title: Forecast envelope in 3D: an ellipsoid, confident where sampled, honest elsewhere
description: Inverse-2.5 truth, Newtonian reference law (no extension adopted). Tier L calibrates gravity against distance from two earlier attempts in two other planes and the current one. Forecasts are issued from the present state for a coasting plan, a dive below the sampled distances and a plane change with an aged engine. Each sample carries a 3x3 position covariance.
units: SI: m, s, m/s, m/s^2, rad. A fix is [azimuth, elevation(, range)] of the inertial direction ship -> target: azimuth = atan2(d_y, d_x) in (-pi, pi], elevation = asin(d_z / |d|). sigma is per component; sigma_az carries the 1 / cos(elevation) of an isotropic pointing error. Attitudes are unit quaternions [w, x, y, z], body to inertial. Accelerometer samples are [f_x, f_y, f_z] in the body frame.
frame: Right-handed inertial. Gauge: body A at the origin and at rest at t = 0 of every attempt (spec 3.4). Body frame: +x forward, +y left, +z up.

propagation.note: Reference setting; all times are multiples of dt. Any propagator whose position error over the arc is below ~1 m reproduces the expected values.

tolerance.numeric: Fits with compare = numeric: |x_impl - x_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref per parameter; |sigma_impl / sigma_ref - 1| <= 0.05; |chi2_impl / chi2_ref - 1| <= 0.02; |rho_impl - rho_ref| <= 0.02. Tier L windows: same boundaries (t0, t1, nFixes) and |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref. Profile nodes: |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.1 sigma_ref.
tolerance.qualitative: Fits with compare = qualitative are grossly misfitted (chi2/nu > 25) or unconverged; only the inequalities in `checks` and any heldOut.pass value are required.
tolerance.physicalClaims: Per check, stated in `checks`. The generator refuses to write a vector whose claims fail.

notes: Expected values: tierL windows and profile, anchor state and covariance, and every forecast point inside the horizon. Tolerance for forecast points: |mean_impl - mean_ref| <= 0.05 sigmaMajor.total; sigmaMajor components within 5% (or 1 m absolute); covTotal entries within 5% of sigmaMajor.total^2. `truth`, `deviation`, `mahalanobis*` and `uncalibratedDeviation` are checks, not estimator outputs.
`sigmaOutOfPlane`, `sigmaInPlaneMajor` and `majorAxisToNormalDeg` are measured against `forecastInputs.orbitNormalNow`, the orbit normal of the present state.
Planned burns are given as resolved attitudes `q`; `attitudeResolution` records how the roll-held rule produced them.
`truth` blocks are for checking only and must never reach the estimator (P11). Measurements whose target is not a modelled body are ignored by that fit.
Covariances of positions are [xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz].

attempts.note: Earlier attempt: coasting arc r 0.75-1.0 r0 (12 h), plane inclined 15 deg.
Earlier attempt: coasting arc r 1.0-1.3 r0 (16 h), plane inclined 80 deg (node 120 deg).
Current attempt: coasting inward from apocentre at 1.2 r0 in a plane inclined 40 deg (node 250 deg), holding one attitude (the `q` on its fixes); data up to now (4 h).

coast.description: Keep coasting; the path stays inside the sampled distances.

dive.description: Retrograde burn of 120 s at 0.15 m/s^2 now, then coast: the path drops below every sampled distance.

plane-change.description: Burn of 120 s at 0.15 m/s^2 along the orbit normal now, with an engine calibration aged by 12 ship days, 250 m/s and one damage event (spec 3.7), then coast.

agedEngine.note: dP ages with the rates of engine.dE

windowRule.label: ASSUMED
windowRule.source: Tier L: a window closes after the bearing sweeps 0.7 rad (40 deg) or ln(range) spans 0.15, with at least 12 fixes. Scale-free, so independent of the 1B scale.
